text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-pool-prod (eu) at 100% allocatable GPUs, queue growth detected (queue_len=18,200). HPA not scaling: custom metrics fetch failing (adapter timeouts). Paging oncall.

nora: acked. I'm oncall. Pulling metrics and app logs. Seeing repeated errors from prometheus-adapter: `504 Gateway Timeout` to /api/v1/query_range. HPA shows "no metrics returned".

diego: looks like a spike from a nightly batch eval hitting prometheus with expensive range queries around 02:08 UTC. That saturated the TSDB and the adapter's request queue.

ash: customer impact: a subset of low-latency customers on eu-west-1 getting 429s and 503s. CS flagged 4 customers, escalating. Latency p95 jumped to 6.2s for infer-real-time route.

sylvie: quick mitigation checklist: (A) prevent new low-priority GPU jobs, (B) increase GPU autoscaling group desired capacity, (C) fallback HPA to local queue-exporter metric, (D) restart prometheus-adapter and metrics-server after throttling queries.

nora: executing (A) now: toggling traffic class for non-critical inference.

```
redwoodctl traffic set-class --env=prod --class=bulk --rate=0.0
```

diego: scaling GPU ASG up 5 nodes as immediate capacity buffer. Using infra runbook-ish command:
```
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name redwood-gpu-prod-eu --desired-capacity 22
```

ops-manager: reminder: watch GCE spot reclaim if using preemptible; don't oversubscribe. Confirm node type p4d-heap.

nora: HPA still stuck waiting on external metric. I'll patch HPA to target the local queue metric temporarily.
```
kubectl -n inference patch hpa infer-worker -p '{"spec":{"metrics":[{"type":"External","external":{"metricName":"queue_length_local","metricSelector":{},"target":{"type":"AverageValue","averageValue":"50"}}}]}}' --type=merge
```

ash: local queue-exporter is present but not enabled in all AZs. Diego, can you flip exporter on for infer-worker nodes in eu-az2 and eu-az3?

diego: enabling exporter daemonset scale, rolling update to ensure it binds to newly coming nodes.

incident-bot: Note: prometheus-adapter error sample: `Get "http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query_range?query=...": net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)`. 

sylvie: I'm throttling heavy prometheus queries and muting a noisy alert rule (heavy-evals-eu). Pausing scheduled evals that started at 02:00 UTC.

diego: adapter queue depth dropping. Restarting adapter to clear stuck requests:
```
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter
```

nora: also restarted metrics-server just in case of stale k8s metrics:
```
kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/metrics-server
```

ash: confirming HPA now sees external metric from queue-exporter. New replicas requested: 6 -> 14. Pods scheduling onto new GPU nodes.

ops-manager: keep an eye on cluster autoscaler; if it starts evicting pods or balancing, we might need to cordon a node to prevent thrash.

sylvie: cordoned a problematic underutilized node and drained it of non-critical pods.

nora: customer update: error rate for affected customers down 80% after scale-up and HPA patch. Still seeing occasional 503s for long-tail requests. CS notified customers at 02:34 UTC.

diego: new nodes online; kube reports GPU pool at ~78% utilization now. Queue length trending down from 18k to 2.2k.

incident-bot: recorded event: autoscaler failed due to `FailedGetExternalMetric: adapter error` at 02:10 UTC.

ops-manager: follow-ups (short-term):
- add local queue-exporter to all worker nodegroups (owner: diego)
- add circuit-breaker and rate-limit to prometheus-adapter (owner: sylvie)
- modify runbook to auto-bump HPA minReplicas if adapter returns 5xx for >2min (owner: nora)
- evaluate retention/queries for nightly evals to avoid TSDB saturation (owner: eng-ml)

nora: creating incident ticket and assigning follow-ups. Will run a postmortem and quantify failed requests and revenue impact.

oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled: nora handing to ash at 03:00 UTC for continued monitoring. Leave notes in incident ticket.

ash: taking handoff. I'll watch queue and adapter alerts. If queue >5k again, we'll revert to emergency scale and reroute low-priority traffic to batch pool.

nora: thanks all. Pasted key commands and logs above. Moving to post-incident stage. :white_check_mark:
